investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Redtrail Shop (online retail); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus (zones eastus-1/eastus-2/eastus-3); network range 10.102.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster redtra-prod-eastus (AKS); Caching tier: self-managed Redis (cache-redis-02, maxmemory 8gb, allkeys-lru) in front of the cart-service PostgreSQL database cart-db-01; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
